versions.localizedDescription:
Be the 1st to Know! 365Scores helps you become an EXPERT OF THE GAME with Live Scores, Pre-Game Stats, In-Depth Data, News Updates, Upcoming Fixtures, Lineups - and everything else you need to stay connected to your favorite players, teams, and competitions.

Join over 150 million sports fans who rely on 365Scores for real-time updates and pre-game stats.

* EXTENSIVE SPORTS COVERAGE
Follow the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, UEFA Champions League, English Premier League, and 2000+ global sports competitions in 10 different types of sports, including top football, soccer, basketball, tennis events and much more – all in one live scores app.

* LIVE SOCCER RESULTS
Get all the latest soccer news and updates, right at your fingertips! Follow you
